controles.affirmation: Judiciaire : environ 100 procedures liees a l'incident Starwood du 30 novembre 2018, toujours pendantes au 30/06/2026 ; mediation en cours, pertes jugees probables, provision non significative, pertes possibles superieures ; 4e circuit ayant annule pour la deuxieme fois la certification de classe en 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, Note 5 : "Following our announcement of the Data Security Incident, approximately 100 lawsuits were filed by consumers and others against us in U.S. federal, U.S. state and Canadian courts... In 2025, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit reversed the District Court's certification of a class of consumer plaintiffs for the second time, and some plaintiffs subsequently filed lawsuits in New York state court on an individual basis... We are progressing in our mediation discussions with the U.S. consumer plaintiffs, and we believe it is probable that we will incur losses in relation to these cases. As of June 30, 2026, we have recorded an accrual... which is not material to our Financial Statements. The Canadian cases remain pending." ; "While we believe it is reasonably possible that we may incur losses in excess of the amounts recorded..."

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : Cost reimbursement revenue 9 902 / 9 587 ; Reimbursed expenses 10 036 / 9 596 (solde -134 / -9). 10-K FY2025 : "Cost reimbursements, net $(299) $(317)" ; comptes 2023 : cost reimbursement revenue 17 413, reimbursed expenses 17 424 (solde -11). controles.affirmation: Bull nuance : "4,5 Mds$ de ligne de credit restent disponibles"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "We are party to a $4.5 billion multicurrency revolving credit agreement (as amended, the \"Credit Facility\"). Available borrowings under the Credit Facility support our commercial paper program and general corporate needs." Le document donne la TAILLE de la facilite, jamais un montant disponible de 4,5 Mds$ ; 1 242 M$ de billets de tresorerie etaient encours au 30/06/2026 et sont adosses a cette facilite.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer par : "une ligne de credit revolving de 4,5 Mds$, qui adosse 1 242 M$ de billets de tresorerie en cours".
